description: P3 consumer-assertion: plugin/references/run-ledger-schema.md defines the completed_steps wave-marker convention (the free-form event.outputs.completed_steps array recorded per completed wave). The standard-delivery and pr-feedback-remediation workflow definitions describe the same per-wave checkpoint semantics in their state descriptions and are the named consumers. Renaming or removing the convention in the schema doc, or either workflow's wave-checkpoint description, without updating the others is an unprotected coupling. The pins claim only that these word sequences exist in these named files; they claim nothing about meaning. The overlord no longer reads or writes the marker, so it has no consumer here; the two JSON-definition consumers stay while the JSON definitions exist.

consumers.pattern: Molt one checkpoint commit for the whole completed wave, not per step.
Molt one checkpoint commit for the whole completed wave of remediation steps, not per step.
